Definition: from G2596 and G4626; to undermine, i.e. (by implication) destroy:--dig down, ruin.
BiblicalUsage: After this I will return and build again the tabernacle of David which is fallen down, and Elijah said they have digged down Thine altars and killed Thy prophets.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God rebuilds what men dig down, and the fallen tabernacle is not the end of the story.
